source.label: Septenary quadratic repair and all-odd bulk normality

reviewer: Codex with one isolated medium reviewer

claims.summary: In characteristic7, for any degree3 polynomial g and c>=9, gF_c+yF_c,y2=1+epsilon7*tau7, has the full residue-chain saturated frame y*tau^j,j<3, and g*tau^a*psi^k,k<=floor((c-a)/7)+floor((c-3-a)/7)+1. For D>=12,D5mod7,c=D+1, nonzero simple root lambda of g and regular beta(epsilon), imposing Aprime(lambda)=beta*A(lambda) on BOTH coordinates gives the full constrained boundary and explicit first two effective coefficients. Two adjacent residue groups determine both domain corrections; errors start at epsilon21.
claims.assessment: Working full-saturation and coefficient proof. Polynomial division, consecutive y-powers in each residue class, independent reductions and a unit two-column constraint minor give the full lattice. Exact original-coordinate equations and the opposite-point ratio derive both corrections, including variation of the first correction. Independent full-polynomial controls verify both domain rows through second order.
claims.rationale: Extends the existing Frobenius smoothing argument to nondivisible bounds and the actual moving codimension-one domain, enabling the last septenary repair. Route-specific use of established residue-chain and saturation methods; no independent novelty claim.
claims.next_action: Complete dimension-eight d2,3,4,5 at primes at least7 from exact original-source certificates and the proved large-characteristic cutoff; higher dimensions and pre-stable thresholds remain open.

claims.summary: In characteristic7, every q=7^(16t+8),t>=0,d=(q+319)/128 has original generic dimension-eight V_(8,d) normal, with orders0..q-2. The actual full exceptional elliptic deformation has exact saturated determinant epsilon-order14: its first eta=epsilon7 induced coefficient is zero, but the corrected second coefficient is nonzero.
claims.assessment: Working uniform proof from the full constrained frame, exact corank1 boundary and four-term kernel. Both-end outer-pole corrections give zero first cut vector, then the required kernel correction gives second vector(0,0,z4-1,0,...),z=u^q. The paired scalar numerator and denominator have surviving u-orders10 and9. Every one of13 cuts matches an independent full-polynomial control; a caught integer-coercion error was corrected before acceptance.
claims.rationale: Repairs the actual source on the complete sparse pure-power obstruction family, closing the final dimension-eight bulk gap without a huge first-member matrix. No independent novelty claim for the general deformation method.
claims.next_action: Complete dimension-eight d2,3,4,5 at primes at least7 from exact original-source certificates and the proved large-characteristic cutoff; higher dimensions and pre-stable thresholds remain open.

claims.summary: For every odd prime p, every field of characteristic p and every d>=6, original generic dimension-eight V_(8,d) has Hasse orders0..128d-321. Low degrees at remaining primes, higher dimensions and pre-stable thresholds are not asserted here.
claims.assessment: Working all-prime bulk theorem combining cor:cube-eight-bulk-sparse-gap with the complete septenary pure-power repair. The two proved scopes exhaust every bulk degree and odd prime; scalar extension preserves the nonzero determinant.
claims.rationale: Closes every odd-prime dimension-eight bulk degree, leaving a finite low-degree complement before the next dimension. No independent novelty claim for the final combination.
claims.next_action: Complete dimension-eight d2,3,4,5 at primes at least7 from exact original-source certificates and the proved large-characteristic cutoff; higher dimensions and pre-stable thresholds remain open.
